name: Animation in-between frame morphing synthesizes intermediate keyframes
description: Verify drawing two distinct poses across multiple animation frames and executing PixiBud AI in-between morphing to generate a smooth intermediate tween frame.

planSteps.description: Select the Pen tool and draw a standing character stick pose on Frame 1
Click the 'Add Frame' button in the bottom animation timeline bar
On Frame 2, draw the character in an outstretched jumping pose
Click back on Frame 1 in the timeline to set it as active
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Click the 'Generate In-Between Frame' action button
Verify a new intermediate frame is inserted into the timeline containing mathematically blended in-between geometry
